author: Local
description: Galactic War only. Home stays small. The first enemy system is 2 planets, then systems ramp to 6. You land on one planet. Every other planet gets 3 enemy commanders, or 4 on the largest systems. A new war starts you with 3 random technologies. Each win offers 5 cards, you take 2, and you can reroll. Start a new war after enabling this mod.
